description: This file defines the jjwg_MarkersDashlet class, which extends the DashletGeneric class to create a custom dashlet for the jjwg_Markers module in the SuiteCRM project. It sets up the dashlet's title, search fields, columns, and seed bean based on metadata and translations.

classes.name: jjwg_MarkersDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet class for displaying jjwg_Markers data within SuiteCRM's dashboard.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with data, sets the title, search fields, columns, and seed bean.
